subject: Request for hackathon promotional credits — IgniteFest July 2026
messages:
From: Alex Gomez <alexg@openscout.org>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 9 Jul 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: IgniteFest — request for promo credits for weekend hackathon

Hi Jasmine,

Hope you’re doing well — I run community partnerships for OpenScout and we’re organizing IgniteFest (July 23–25), a community hackathon focused on civic-tech and climate tooling. Last year we had ~120 participants in 40 teams; this year we expect ~200 participants.

We’d love Redwood to be a platform sponsor: specifically, a short-term credits package and a couple of trial seats for our mentors over the hack weekend. Our rough estimate is ~25–50k tokens per team (ballpark) for model-based helpers and demos, so we’re asking for a promotional credit pool of 250k–400k tokens and 3 trial seats with priority support for July 23–26.

I attached a quick sponsorship deck and an event rundown. If you need more detail on expected usage patterns or the repo/attendee policies, happy to share. Is this something your community team can support? If so, any short approval steps we should follow?

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Gomez
Community Partnerships, OpenScout
organizers@openscout.org
attach: ignitefest-sponsorship-deck.pdf (application/pdf, 1.2MB)
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Gomez <alexg@openscout.org>
Date: Thu, 9 Jul 2026 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: IgniteFest — request for promo credits for weekend hackathon

Hi Alex — great to hear from you and congrats on the growth. We’d love to support IgniteFest. A few quick clarifying questions so I can route this internally: 

- Do teams run in public repos or private repos? (public repos help us qualify as a community promo)
- Which open models/approach do you expect participants to use (generation, embeddings, fine-tune)?
- Do you need single-use tokens for mentors or shared account access?
- Can you fill our sponsorship form so we have legal/marketing details: https://forms.redwood.ai/hackathon-sponsorship

If it’s helpful I can propose an initial allocation (we’ve historically offered a 300k token pool + 3 mentor seats for similar-sized hackathons). I’ll check partner quota and get back with a firm number and any required short T&Cs.

If you want to hop on a quick 20-min call next week I can bring our community lead.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Community Programs | Redwood Inference
jasmine@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0187

Folks — forwarding a request from OpenScout for IgniteFest (Jul 23–25). They’re asking for a promotional credit pool and 3 mentor seats (priority support) for the weekend. Event looks community-first (civic/climate) and they have ~200 participants expected. Deck attached.

My ask: can we approve 300k tokens + 3 mentor trial seats as a standard package? They indicated 250k–400k so 300k is midpoint. If approved I’ll set up a short HubSpot record and send the sponsorship form. If we want to escalate (bigger marketing tie-in or paid sponsorship) we can route qual. Also note we should include a short expiry (credits valid for July 23–28) and no production/data retention SLA.

Proposed quick credit schedule (attached): proposed-credit-schedule.csv

Thanks — JJ
